missions.title: Complete the 2FUNC core and its value, recording, supply, and release-preparation mechanisms

in_scope: 2FUNC economic core and exact value calculations
Data integrity, identity correctness, and idempotency
Enforcement of approved supply and release rules
Relevant tests, documentation, and release-readiness checks
Minimum necessary integration of governance-approved activity with the 2FUNC value flow
out_of_scope: Parallel value engine, ledger, or persistent ecosystem database

stages.title: Build and validate the project workflow control system
acceptance: Mission document exists and its content is checked
Workflow guard read-only inspection commands and controlled mission-management commands are implemented and validated
Mission catalog and mission-management controls are implemented

stages.title: Define and approve the evidence-based technical stage plan for 2FUNC
acceptance: Existing completed work is distinguished from unfinished work using actual evidence
Remaining technical stages and dependencies are explicitly defined
User approves the technical stage plan
